title: Employee Compensation Policy
content:
Employee Compensation Policy v3.0

The Employee Compensation Policy is owned by the HR Team and managed by the Compensation Committee.

Salary Structure:
- Level 1 (Junior): $60,000 - $85,000 base salary
- Level 2 (Mid): $85,000 - $120,000 base salary
- Level 3 (Senior): $120,000 - $160,000 base salary
- Level 4 (Staff): $160,000 - $200,000 base salary
- Level 5 (Principal): $200,000 - $250,000 base salary

Annual bonuses are calculated as a percentage of base salary:
- Junior: 5-10%
- Mid: 10-15%
- Senior: 15-20%
- Staff: 20-25%
- Principal: 25-35%

Stock options are granted annually during the compensation review cycle in March. Vesting period is 4 years with a 1-year cliff.

The HR Team conducts compensation benchmarking twice per year using market data from Radford and Mercer surveys.

Compensation adjustments take effect on April 1st each year. Off-cycle adjustments require VP-level approval.

This document is restricted to HR and Management roles only. Engineering and other departments must not access this information.
